SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM driverStandings ds
JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON ds.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE r.year IN (SELECT year FROM seasons ORDER BY year DESC LIMIT 3)
GROUP BY d.driverId
HAVING SUM(ds.points) >= 40;

    FROM races 
    ORDER BY year DESC 
    LIMIT 3

WITH qual_best AS (
    SELECT 
        q.driverId,
        c.length,
        MIN(
            CASE WHEN q.q1 IS NOT NULL AND q.q1 <> '' THEN (
                CAST(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 
                + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
            ) END,
            CASE WHEN q.q2 IS NOT NULL AND q.q2 <> '' THEN (
                CAST(substr(q.q2, 1, instr(q.q2, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 
                + CAST(substr(q.q2, instr(q.q2, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
            ) END,
            CASE WHEN q.q3 IS NOT NULL AND q.q3 <> '' THEN (
                CAST(substr(q.q3, 1, instr(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 
                + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
            ) END
        ) AS best_time_sec
    FROM qualifying q
    JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
    JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
    GROUP BY q.driverId, q.raceId, c.length
)
SELECT 
    d.driverId,
    d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name,
    AVG((c.length / qb.best_time_sec) * 3600.0) AS avg_speed_kmh
FROM qual_best qb
JOIN drivers d ON qb.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN circuits c ON c.length = qb.length   -- reuse length for calculation
GROUP BY d.driverId, driver_name
ORDER BY avg_speed_kmh DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH qualifying_sessions AS (
    SELECT 
        q.driverId,
        CASE 
            WHEN q.q3 IS NOT NULL AND q.q3 != '' AND LENGTH(TRIM(q.q3)) > 0 THEN q.q3
            WHEN q.q2 IS NOT NULL AND q.q2 != '' AND LENGTH(TRIM(q.q2)) > 0 THEN q.q2
            WHEN q.q1 IS NOT NULL AND q.q1 != '' AND LENGTH(TRIM(q.q1)) > 0 THEN q.q1
            ELSE NULL
        END AS qualifying_time
    FROM qualifying q
    WHERE (
        (q.q3 IS NOT NULL AND q.q3 != '' AND LENGTH(TRIM(q.q3)) > 0)
        OR (q.q2 IS NOT NULL AND q.q2 != '' AND LENGTH(TRIM(q.q2)) > 0)
        OR (q.q1 IS NOT NULL AND q.q1 != '' AND LENGTH(TRIM(q.q1)) > 0)
    )
),
qualifying_times_seconds AS (
    SELECT
        driverId,
        CAST(SUBSTR(qualifying_time, 1, INSTR(qualifying_time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 
        + CAST(SUBSTR(qualifying_time, INSTR(qualifying_time, ':') + 1) AS REAL) AS time_seconds
    FROM qualifying_sessions
),
driver_avg_times AS (
    SELECT
        driverId,
        ROUND(AVG(time_seconds), 4) AS avg_qualifying_time
    FROM qualifying_times_seconds
    GROUP BY driverId
)
SELECT
    ROUND(6048000 / (d.forename || ' ' || d.surname) * 3600.0, 2) AS average_speed_kmh
FROM driver_avg_times dat
JOIN drivers d ON dat.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM circuits c, races r 
    WHERE r.circuitId = c.circuitId 
    LIMIT 1
)

WITH q AS (
    SELECT
        driverId,
        raceId,
        CASE WHEN q1 IS NOT NULL AND q1!='' THEN
            (CAST(SUBSTR(q1, 1, INSTR(q1, ':')-1) AS INTEGER)*60 +
             CAST(SUBSTR(q1, INSTR(q1, ':' )+1, INSTR(q1, '.')-INSTR(q1, ':')) AS INTEGER) +
             CAST(SUBSTR(q1, INSTR(q1, '.')+1) AS INTEGER)/1000.0)
        END AS t1,
        CASE WHEN q2 IS NOT NULL AND q2!='' THEN
            (CAST(SUBSTR(q2, 1, INSTR(q2, ':')-1) AS INTEGER)*60 +
             CAST(SUBSTR(q2, INSTR(q2, ':' )+1, INSTR(q2, '.')-INSTR(q2, ':')) AS INTEGER) +
             CAST(SUBSTR(q2, INSTR(q2, '.')+1) AS INTEGER)/1000.0)
        END AS t2,
        CASE WHEN q3 IS NOT NULL AND q3!='' THEN
            (CAST(SUBSTR(q3, 1, INSTR(q3, ':')-1) AS INTEGER)*60 +
             CAST(SUBSTR(q3, INSTR(q3, ':' )+1, INSTR(q3, '.')-INSTR(q3, ':')) AS INTEGER) +
             CAST(SUBSTR(q3, INSTR(q3, '.')+1) AS INTEGER)/1000.0)
        END AS t3
    FROM qualifying
),
best AS (
    SELECT
        driverId,
        raceId,
        (SELECT MIN(x) FROM (SELECT t1 AS x UNION ALL SELECT t2 UNION ALL SELECT t3) WHERE x IS NOT NULL) AS best_sec
    FROM q
)
SELECT
    d.forename,
    d.surname
FROM drivers d
JOIN (
    SELECT
        driverId,
        AVG(1.0/best_sec) AS avg_inv_time
    FROM best
    GROUP BY driverId
    ORDER BY avg_inv_time DESC
    LIMIT 3
) ra ON d.driverId = ra.driverId;

WITH
    lap_stats AS (
        SELECT lt.driverId,
               AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_ms
        FROM lapTimes lt
        JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
        WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2009 AND 2019
        GROUP BY lt.driverId
    ),
    qual_stats AS (
        SELECT q.driverId,
               AVG(q.position) AS avg_qual_pos
        FROM qualifying q
        JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
        WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2009 AND 2019
          AND q.position IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY q.driverId
    ),
    race_stats AS (
        SELECT res.driverId,
               AVG(res.position) AS avg_fin_pos,
               SUM(CASE WHEN res.fastestLap IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fastest_lap_cnt
        FROM results res
        JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
        WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2009 AND 2019
          AND res.position IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY res.driverId
    )
SELECT d.driverId,
       d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name,
       ( (1000000.0 / ls.avg_lap_ms) * 0.25
         + (1.0 / qs.avg_qual_pos) * 0.25
         + (1.0 / rs.avg_fin_pos) * 0.25
         + (rs.fastest_lap_cnt * 0.25) ) AS performance_index
FROM drivers d
JOIN lap_stats ls ON d.driverId = ls.driverId
JOIN qual_stats qs ON d.driverId = qs.driverId
JOIN race_stats rs ON d.driverId = rs.driverId
ORDER BY performance_index DESC;

WITH driver_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        d.driverId,
        d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name,
        ROUND(AVG(q.position), 2) AS avg_qualifying_position,
        ROUND(AVG(r.position), 2) AS avg_race_position,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN r.rank = 1 THEN 1 END) AS fastest_laps_achieved,
        ROUND((SELECT AVG(lt2.milliseconds) FROM lapTimes lt2 WHERE lt2.driverId = d.driverId AND lt2.raceId IN (SELECT r2.raceId FROM results r2 JOIN races r3 ON r2.raceId = r3.raceId WHERE r3.year BETWEEN 2009 AND 2019)), 0) AS avg_lap_time_ms
    FROM drivers d
    JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
    JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
    JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverId = q.driverId AND r.raceId = q.raceId
    WHERE ra.year BETWEEN 2009 AND 2019
      AND q.position IS NOT NULL
      AND r.position IS NOT NULL
      AND r.position < 20
    GROUP BY d.driverId
)
SELECT 
    driver_name,
    ROUND(
        ((50 - COALESCE(avg_qualifying_position, 25)) * 2) +
        ((50 - COALESCE(avg_race_position, 25)) * 2.5) +
        (fastest_laps_achieved * 10) +
        (MAX_avg_lap_time - avg_lap_time_ms) / 10000
    , 2) AS performance_index
FROM driver_stats ds,
     (SELECT MAX(avg_lap_time_ms) AS MAX_avg_lap_time FROM driver_stats) ref
ORDER BY performance_index DESC;

WITH filtered_races AS (
  SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE year BETWEEN 2009 AND 2019
),
driver_agg AS (
  SELECT
    d.driverId,
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    AVG(l.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms,
    STDDEV(q.position) AS qualify_pos_stddev,
    AVG(rs.position) AS avg_finish_position,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN rs.fastestLap IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS fastest_lap_count
  FROM drivers d
  JOIN results rs ON rs.driverId = d.driverId
  JOIN filtered_races fr ON rs.raceId = fr.raceId
  LEFT JOIN lapTimes l ON l.raceId = rs.raceId AND l.driverId = rs.driverId
  LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON q.raceId = rs.raceId AND q.driverId = rs.driverId
  GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname
),
metrics AS (
  SELECT
    driverId,
    forename,
    surname,
    avg_lap_time_ms,
    qualify_pos_stddev,
    avg_finish_position,
    fastest_lap_count,
    MIN(avg_lap_time_ms) OVER () AS min_lap,
    MAX(avg_lap_time_ms) OVER () AS max_lap,
    MIN(qualify_pos_stddev) OVER () AS min_std,
    MAX(qualify_pos_stddev) OVER () AS max_std,
    MIN(avg_finish_position) OVER () AS min_finish,
    MAX(avg_finish_position) OVER () AS max_finish,
    MIN(fastest_lap_count) OVER () AS min_fast,
    MAX(fastest_lap_count) OVER () AS max_fast
  FROM driver_agg
),
norm AS (
  SELECT
    driverId,
    forename,
    surname,
    CASE WHEN max_lap = min_lap THEN 0.5 ELSE (max_lap - avg_lap_time_ms) / (max_lap - min_lap) END AS norm_lap,
    CASE WHEN max_std = min_std THEN 0.5 ELSE (max_std - qualify_pos_stddev) / (max_std - min_std) END AS norm_consistency,
    CASE WHEN max_finish = min_finish THEN 0.5 ELSE (max_finish - avg_finish_position) / (max_finish - min_finish) END AS norm_finish,
    CASE WHEN max_fast = min_fast THEN 0.5 ELSE (fastest_lap_count - min_fast) / (max_fast - min_fast) END AS norm_fastest
  FROM metrics
)
SELECT
  forename || ' ' || surname AS driver_name,
  (0.3 * norm_lap + 0.2 * norm_consistency + 0.3 * norm_finish + 0.2 * norm_fastest) AS performance_index
FROM norm
ORDER BY performance_index DESC;

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver,
       CASE 
         WHEN SUM(r.points) >= 100 THEN 'A'
         WHEN SUM(r.points) >= 50  THEN 'B'
         WHEN SUM(r.points) >= 10  THEN 'C'
         ELSE 'D'
       END AS grade
FROM results r
JOIN races ra   ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN drivers d  ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE ra.year = 2020
GROUP BY d.driverId;

JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId

WITH driver_points AS (
    SELECT d.driverId,
           d.forename,
           d.surname,
           d.nationality,
           COALESCE(SUM(r.points), 0) AS total_points,
           COALESCE(SUM(ds.wins), 0)   AS total_wins
    FROM drivers d
    LEFT JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
    LEFT JOIN driverStandings ds ON d.driverId = ds.driverId
    GROUP BY d.driverId
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT driverId,
           forename,
           surname,
           nationality,
           total_points,
           total_wins,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_points DESC) AS rank
    FROM driver_points
)
SELECT forename,
       surname,
       nationality,
       total_points AS points,
       rank
FROM ranked
WHERE total_wins > 0
ORDER BY rank;

WITH latest_season AS (
        SELECT MAX(year) AS year FROM seasons
    ),
    season_races AS (
        SELECT r.raceId
        FROM races r
        JOIN latest_season ls ON r.year = ls.year
    ),
    driver_points AS (
        SELECT ds.driverId, SUM(ds.points) AS total_points
        FROM driverStandings ds
        JOIN season_races sr ON ds.raceId = sr.raceId
        GROUP BY ds.driverId
    )
SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name,
       dp.total_points,
       CASE
           WHEN dp.total_points >= 200 THEN 'Excellent'
           WHEN dp.total_points >= 100 THEN 'Good'
           WHEN dp.total_points >= 50  THEN 'Average'
           ELSE 'Poor'
       END AS category
FROM driver_points dp
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = dp.driverId

WITH street_circuits AS (
    SELECT circuitId
    FROM circuits
    WHERE lower(name) LIKE '%street%'
       OR lower(name) LIKE '%city%'
       OR lower(location) LIKE '%city%'
       OR lower(name) LIKE '%monaco%'
       OR lower(location) LIKE '%monaco%'
),
decade_avg AS (
    SELECT (r.year / 10) * 10 AS decade,
           AVG(CAST(res.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL)) AS avg_speed
    FROM races r
    JOIN street_circuits sc ON r.circuitId = sc.circuitId
    JOIN results res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE res.fastestLapSpeed IS NOT NULL AND res.fastestLapSpeed <> ''
    GROUP BY decade
),
race_fastest_pit AS (
    SELECT raceId,
           MIN(milliseconds) AS fastest_pit_ms
    FROM pitStops
    GROUP BY raceId
)
SELECT (r.year / 10) * 10 AS decade,
       da.avg_speed,
       r.raceId,
       rfp.fastest_pit_ms
FROM races r
JOIN street_circuits sc ON r.circuitId = sc.circuitId
JOIN race_fastest_pit rfp ON rfp.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN decade_avg da ON da.decade = (r.year / 10) * 10
ORDER BY decade, r.raceId;

    SELECT c.circuitId
    FROM circuits c
    WHERE 
        LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%monaco%' OR
        LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%singapore%' OR
        LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%baku%' OR
        LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%street%' OR
        LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%city%' OR
        LOWER(c.location) LIKE '%monaco%' OR
        LOWER(c.location) LIKE '%singapore%' OR
        LOWER(c.location) LIKE '%baku%' OR
        LOWER(c.country) LIKE '%monaco%'
)
SELECT 
    (r.year / 10) * 10 AS decade,
    AVG(CAST(res.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL)) AS avg_fastest_lap_speed,
    (SELECT MIN(ps2.milliseconds) FROM pitStops ps2 WHERE ps2.raceId = r.raceId) AS fastest_pit_stop_ms
FROM races r
INNER JOIN street_circuits sc ON r.circuitId = sc.circuitId
INNER JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId AND res.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL AND res.fastestLapSpeed IS NOT NULL
LEFT JOIN pitStops ps ON r.raceId = ps.raceId
GROUP BY (r.year / 10) * 10
ORDER BY decade

WITH street_races AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, r.year
    FROM races r
    JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
    WHERE 
        c.name LIKE '%Street%' OR
        c.location LIKE '%Street%' OR
        c.name LIKE '%Monaco%' OR
        c.name LIKE '%Marina Bay%' OR
        c.name LIKE '%Baku%' OR
        c.name LIKE '%Valencia%' OR
        c.location LIKE '%Monaco%' OR
        c.location LIKE '%Marina Bay%' OR
        c.location LIKE '%Baku%' OR
        c.location LIKE '%Valencia%'
)
SELECT 
    (sr.year/10)*10 AS decade,
    AVG(res.fastestLapSpeed) AS avg_fastest_lap_speed,
    MIN(pit.milliseconds) AS fastest_pit_stop_milliseconds
FROM street_races sr
JOIN results res ON sr.raceId = res.raceId
JOIN pitStops pit ON sr.raceId = pit.raceId
WHERE res.fastestLapSpeed IS NOT NULL
  AND pit.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY decade
ORDER BY decade;

FROM constructors c
JOIN constructorResults cr ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId
JOIN races r ON cr.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE r.year = 2009
GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name
HAVING SUM(cr.points) = (
    SELECT MAX(total_pts) FROM (
        SELECT SUM(cr2.points) AS total_pts
        FROM constructorResults cr2
        JOIN races r2 ON cr2.raceId = r2.raceId
        WHERE r2.year = 2009
        GROUP BY cr2.constructorId
    )
);

votes.sql:
SELECT c.name,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.status <> 'Finished' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_incidents,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Accident' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accidents,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Collision' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS collisions,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Engine' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS engine_failures
FROM circuits c
JOIN races r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
JOIN results res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN status s ON s.statusId = res.statusId
GROUP BY c.circuitId
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN s.status <> 'Finished' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY total_incidents DESC;

WITH incident_counts AS (
    SELECT c.circuitId,
           c.name,
           COUNT(*) AS incident_count
    FROM "circuits" c
    JOIN "races" r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
    JOIN "results" re ON r.raceId = re.raceId
    JOIN "status" s ON re.statusId = s.statusId
    WHERE s.status IN ('Accident', 'Collision')
    GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.name
),
total_races AS (
    SELECT c.circuitId,
           c.name,
           COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId) AS race_count
    FROM "circuits" c
    JOIN "races" r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
    GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.name
),
rates AS (
    SELECT i.circuitId,
           i.name,
           (i.incident_count * 1.0) / t.race_count AS incident_rate
    FROM incident_counts i
    JOIN total_races t ON i.circuitId = t.circuitId
),
avg_rate AS (
    SELECT AVG(incident_rate) AS avg_incident_rate
    FROM rates
)
SELECT r.name
FROM rates r, avg_rate a
WHERE r.incident_rate > a.avg_incident_rate;
